stance_rationale: The optimizer draft is a design memo, not a verifiable optimizer package: weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, covariance.parquet, final optimization_package.json, and optimizer challenge note are absent. More seriously, the design explicitly permits a 25-35 or 40-name union via per-sleeve reinterpretation, conflicting with the max_names=20 hard constraint.

hard_constraints_audit.audit_note: Actual portfolio-level n_names/max_w/sum/long-only/turnover cannot be verified because weights.csv is missing; design max union is 40 and forecast union is 25-35.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Design-only Pareto protocol; no realized net_ir/cost-adjusted/heavy-tail-adjusted ranking exists.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: 15bps and turnover formulas are stated, but no schedule exists to compute realized turnover, a_t switch churn, or net_IR.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O5: design permits total union support up to 40 and forecasts 25-35 names, above max_names=20 hard.
RF-O7: no weights.csv, so portfolio-level sum_weights=1 cannot be verified.
RF-O9: no as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected schedule exists.
RF-O13: turnover is unmeasured; A5 uses <=6.0 while mandate is <600% annual.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Only formula w_final=(1-a_t)w_1715+a_t w_comp is provided; no blended SR/MDD/IR/TDC measurement exists.

rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O1: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: no alpha_scores.parquet or weights.csv to test top-alpha weight realization.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O3: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: no schedule to measure micro-rebalance churn.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O4: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: no constraint sensitivity run; bound-relax concentration unknown.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O5: FAIL: max_names hard is reinterpreted per sleeve while union may be 25-40.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O8: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: CVaR breach unknown; no infeasibility_report issued.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O10: FAIL: reported 3 candidates undercounts 16 injection candidates and 9 method alternatives.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O11: FAIL: alpha RF-A1 remains empirical-unverified; confidence-aware MVO/BL shrinkage is marked N/A.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O12: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: Hill alpha/heavy-tail condition is unmeasured.
rf_optimizer_audit.RF-O13: FAIL_UNVERIFIED: turnover is not measured against <600% hard.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv is absent, the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_003 directory is absent, and alpha_scores.parquet/covariance.parquet are absent; RF-O9 and all hard-constraint checks are therefore unverifiable.

The design explicitly forecasts total support of 25-35 names and admits a possible 40-name union, then redefines max_names as per-sleeve. AX-007 multi-sleeve exception may address mechanism risk, but it does not override the user's portfolio-level max_names=20 hard mandate.

Method shopping accounting is inconsistent: method_shopping_log reports 3 candidates, while the optimizer design selects over 16 stage/a_max candidates and also defines 9 alternative methods. This bypasses the <=10 candidate cap by relabeling candidate searches as design grids.
No net_IR, turnover, estimated cost, or a_t switch cost is measured. Cost-aware language and 15bps formulas cannot clear RF-O2/RF-O13 without a time-series weight schedule.

Optimizer alignment with alpha/risk findings is not evidenced: alpha RF-A1 remains unverified, Hill alpha/CVaR risk is unmeasured, and covariance PSD plus condition<=100 cannot be checked without covariance.parquet.

Charter No Silent Override is incomplete for the optimizer: codex_round_completed=false, final optimization_package.json is absent, and challenge_note_optimizer-research.md is absent despite known max_names and artifact gaps.
p_bad timing remains fragile across request and package text: p_bad(t) and p_bad(t+1) both appear in the lineage. Without implemented as_of_date weights, this can become same-period overlay leakage.
Sequential Admission is protocol-only: TDC vs PG2, replacement/integration scenarios, and blended SR/MDD/IR are not measured, so L-219 family saturation and AX-008 integration evidence are absent.

supporting_arguments: The draft does clearly label many quantities as design-only and Forge-deferred.
The Pareto admission protocol includes useful gates for MDD, good-state drag, bad-state improvement, turnover, correlation, and p_bad AUC.
The optimizer does not appear to mutate alpha vectors or Sigma directly; it references alpha/risk packages as inputs.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a is allowed to omit weights.csv while being submitted to the optimizer-critic matrix.
Whether max_names=20 is portfolio-level hard or can be reinterpreted as per-sleeve; base context says 20 hard.
Whether the <=10 method-shopping cap counts the 16 injection candidates and 9 method alternatives.
Whether turnover cap should be strictly <6.0 or the draft's <=6.0 admission threshold.
Whether a cash sleeve and max_w shrink to 0.10 are required for CRISIS/small-sample fallback.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest optimizer assumption is that max_names=20 hard can be reinterpreted as per-sleeve while deploying a 25-35 or 40-name total union without violating RF-O5 or requiring explicit infeasibility escalation.
rebuttal_required: Produce weights.csv with schema as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected and at least 60 monthly sig_dates.
Prove portfolio-level, not only per-sleeve, n_names<=20, 0<=w_i<=0.20, sum_weights=1, long-only, liquidity>=2e8, and annual turnover<600%.
Produce alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet; verify Date x Ticker scores, PSD, post-shrink condition<=100, and Hill/CVaR metrics.
If per-sleeve max_names is intended, provide explicit Q-Lead/Governor mandate changing the hard constraint interpretation plus Hook schema support.
Replace the 3-candidate method_shopping_log with an effective search-count log covering 16 stage/a_max candidates, 9 methods, lambda grids, and label choices.
Issue challenge_note_optimizer-research.md and an infeasibility_report for max_names, missing artifacts, CVaR unknowns, and turnover unknowns.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The design may be a coherent Forge plan, but AX-008 cannot pass because there is no Forge evidence, no Architect evidence, no optimizer challenge note, and no verifiable weight schedule.

optimizer_specific_questions: Is max_names=20 a total portfolio hard constraint or a per-sleeve convention, and who authorized that reinterpretation?
Where is weights.csv with as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected and >=60 sig_dates?
Does the method-shopping cap count 16 injection candidates and 9 method alternatives, or only the three meta-design choices?
What is realized net_IR after 15bps one-way cost and a_t switch churn?
If CRISIS sample is thin, why is there no max_w=0.10 boundary shrink or cash sleeve?
